question:
The only goal ever scored by a goalkeeper from open play in a FIFA finals tournament was conceded by me.
Years later, I became the first to keep clean sheets in the first five games of a European Championship.
I've played with the likes of James Rodríguez, Dele Alli & Wayne Rooney.

style.why: The hook is excellent and memorable (the only open-play keeper goal in a World Cup), creating strong tension with the clean sheet record. However, it loses a point because the final clue list (James Rodríguez, Dele Alli & Wayne Rooney) all point to one club (Everton), which violates the style guide’
style.fix: Replace the Everton-centric teammate list with names from different stages of his career or national team to spread the clues. alternatives.question:
In 2011 I conceded the only goal scored by a goalkeeper from open play in the history of a FIFA finals tournament.
Years later, I became the first goalkeeper to keep clean sheets in the first five games of a European Championship.
I've played with the likes of James Rodríguez, Jack Grealish & Wayne Rooney.

In 2021 I set a new all-time England record for the most consecutive scoreless minutes posted by a goalkeeper.
Although my reception among pundits has been mixed, I have now made more World Cup appearances for my country than any other player besides Peter Shilton.
I've shared a pitch with the likes of Dele Alli & Jude Bellingham.

wording will date: The claim about holding the all-time record for consecutive scoreless minutes is stated in the present tense and could be invalidated by a future performance.; The claim about World Cup appearances is stated as a current record/ranking that could change in future tournaments.
